result.title: CVTA: Cross-Variable Temporal Attention for Multivariate Irregular Time Series Prediction
result.comment: Accepted at the Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Main Track
result.summary: Irregularly sampled multivariate time series arise in many real-world domains such as healthcare, climate science, and large-scale monitoring systems. Characterized by asynchronous observations and heterogeneity across variables, such time series pose significant challenges for forecasting. In this work, we introduce Cross-Variable Temporal Attention (CVTA), a short-term, continuous-time forecasting framework that learns prediction functions from its compact, interpretable state summarizing recent temporal dynamics across variables. CVTA uses Variable-Conditioned Embeddings to project heterogeneous variables into variable-specific latent spaces, and applies temporal attention to capture cross-variable dependencies from this state. Furthermore, we demonstrate that CVTA can be integrated as an auxiliary module into existing state-of-the-art prediction models through a dynamic meta-decision model. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world benchmarks show that CVTA achieves strong short-term predictive accuracy, supports efficient online inference, improves existing prediction models when used as an auxiliary module, and learns attention patterns that align well with domain knowledge.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CVTA，一个面向不规则采样多变量时间序列的短时连续时间预测框架：用变量条件嵌入把异质变量投影到各自 latent 空间，并基于一个紧凑可解释的近期动态状态做时序注意力，捕捉跨变量依赖，还可作为辅助模块经动态元决策接入现有预测模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 非多模态视觉工作，但其「紧凑状态 + 跨变量注意力 + 动态元决策组合」可能为 LVR 的内部状态摘要、跨实体（视觉 token）依赖聚合以及 latent 与外部计算模块的切换提供可核查的机制线索。
